name: Interface name
secretPlaceholder: Leave blank to retain existing credentials; e.g. Bearer …
noBindingHint: Unbound tasks do not send events
saveFailed: Unable to save. Check the configuration.
emptyTargets: No destinations configured. Add an interface and explicitly bind the tasks that should send events.
emptyRecords: Events from explicitly bound tasks will appear here.
newCameraHint: Enter an RTSP URL for a new camera
sourceHint: Leave blank when reusing a camera
sourceRequired: Select a camera or enter its RTSP URL
votesInvalid: Matching frames cannot exceed the voting window
taskSaved: Configuration saved. Enable it in Recognition algorithms and bind an event interface.
modelsMissing: Install compatible plate detection and plate OCR models on this gateway first.
upgradeRequired: Upgrade the gateway to use event interfaces.
allTaskEvents: All event types from the selected task only
tcpIntro: The gateway is a TCP server. Business clients connect, authenticate, and subscribe to events. Browsers cannot open raw TCP sockets.
notListening: The TCP port is not listening. Check the gateway service and port configuration.
imageHttpUnavailable: The event image HTTP service is disabled. Enable the gateway console HTTP entrance first.
generateFirst: Generate a subscriber key and store it on the receiving client before enabling the stream.
rotateWarning: Existing clients will disconnect and must authenticate with the new key.
oneTimeKey: This key is shown only now. Store it securely on the receiving client.
protocolHint: One UTF-8 JSON object per line. Use the subscriber key as the HMAC-SHA256 key and the nonce string's UTF-8 bytes as the message. Send auth, wait for authenticated, then subscribe. Empty filters select all.
liveHint: Only events created after subscription are sent. Events missed while disconnected are not replayed. Download images promptly using their expiring signed HTTP URLs. The server sends heartbeats.
eventFieldsHint: The example below is an area intrusion event. The image URL uses the box IP for this TCP connection; sha256 verifies the downloaded JPEG bytes. The common recognition result is in data.result. attributes contains optional algorithm-specific fields and is empty here. Plate fields appear only for the relevant algorithm.
